name: zipper-security-rules-tests
//: Isolated from the app packages on purpose: these dependencies are test-only and must never reach a deploy bundle. Run from the REPO ROOT so the emulator picks up firebase.json (storage emulator 9199, firestore emulator 8080).

scripts.//test: Needs Java for the emulator. Loads ../storage.rules and ../firestore.rules from disk — nothing touches the real project.
scripts.test: npm run test:storage && npm run test:firestore && npm run test:phase1a && npm run test:ugp && npm run test:p1gov && npm run test:p1mfa && npm run test:p1mfa:storage && npm run test:p1mfa:auth
scripts.test:storage: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only storage,firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/storage.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:firestore: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/firestore.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:phase1a: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/firestore.phase1a.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:ugp: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/firestore.ugp.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:p1gov: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/firestore.p1gov.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:p1mfa: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/firestore.p1mfa.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:p1mfa:storage: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only storage,firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/storage.p1mfa.rules.test.mjs"
scripts.test:p1mfa:auth: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-zipper "node tests/auth.p1mfa.emulator.test.mjs"
